canonicalFieldHashes.name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
canonicalFieldHashes.description: A hearty and nutritious meal featuring lean ground beef, rice, and a variety of vegetables, topped with melted cheese.
canonicalFieldHashes.recipeIngredient: ["½ pound lean ground beef (15% fat)","¾ cup chopped onion (¾ medium onion)","1 cup uncooked white rice","1 can (15 ounces) diced tomatoes (about 2 medium fresh tomatoes)","1½ cups vegetables, fresh, frozen, or canned and drained (zucchini, bell pepper, broccoli, corn, cauliflower)","1¾ cups water","1½ teaspoons chili powder","1 tablespoon oregano","1 teaspoon salt","½ cup (2 ounces) shredded cheese"]
canonicalFieldHashes.recipeInstructions: [{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Cook beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until no longer pink. Drain fat.","name":"Cook the beef"},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Add onion and cook until soft, about 3 to 5 minutes.","name":"Add the onion"},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Add rice, tomatoes, vegetables, water and spices. Stir and bring to a boil.","name":"Combine ingredients"},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add more water if needed.","name":"Simmer the mixture"},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cheese and cover for 1 to 2 minutes to allow cheese to melt. Serve warm.","name":"Add cheese"}]
